items.context: AI Applications department; owns architecture, deployment, and AI quality for the real-time AI interpretation platform Abestar Live and existing translation products, and designed the team's AI-agent workflow
jobDesc: Drove the AI interpretation product Abestar Live from POC to production and set the standards for its architecture, deployment, and AI quality.
Drove an eval-first practice: every prompt or model change runs a fixed evaluation and cost measurement first, so release decisions rest on data.

Drove the team's adoption of AI-agent collaboration: task dispatch, code review, and merging run through agents, with clear rules for the split between people and AI: agents handle low-risk changes, people own sensitive ones.
Drove deployment standardization: projects moved onto one shared CI/CD template and release process with zero-downtime switches.
Drove an observability and security baseline: centralized monitoring and alerting plus regular security scans became the shared floor for every project.

items.context: Dating and social startup; sole engineer across the Flutter app, NestJS backend, and deployment
jobDesc: Brought AI into both the product and the development process: shipped six Claude features, two of them in paid tiers, and worked with agents through rule files and automated verification loops.
Stabilized subscription revenue by completing auto-renewal and failed-payment retries; monthly revenue went from NT$210K to NT$380K.
Made performance and cloud cost part of routine ownership, tuning queries, indexes, and cloud architecture together for a 180ms API average and monthly cloud spend down from US$1,200 to US$400.
Built the delivery pipeline alone, from development to store release: CI/CD, iOS and Android launches, and a RAG support agent with human handoff.

items.context: Game and live-streaming platform; joined in 2020 as a backend engineer, engineering manager from January 2023
jobDesc: Led an 11-person cross-functional team (backend, frontend, QA) and owned multiple products from design to launch.
Led the microservice and event-driven architecture (Kafka, Redis) carrying a peak of a thousand transactions and orders per second.
Turned releases into a process: a release checklist moved release risk from individual habit to a process check.
Established monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting standards so on-call engineers could isolate problems by following set steps.
Made design review and code review the shared development standard across product lines.
As a backend engineer: led the refactor of a legacy system into layered modules and was lead backend on a blockchain fair-random-number platform.

items.context: Software consultancy; responsible for 7 client systems
jobDesc: Led several client systems from zero to delivery (lending, video streaming, equipment dispatch, e-commerce), owning schema and API architecture.
Replaced manual releases with automated deployment, with the video platform built on a serverless AWS architecture.
Established unit and functional testing so every delivery covered its regression surface.
Chose the stack per client environment (C#, Node.js, React, Salesforce).
Served as first point of contact for new hires, maintaining environment setup and project docs.
